one_month_reasoning: The window's last close is Fri 2026-10-30 (11/01 is a Sunday). DOCN has not announced a Q3 date; its EDGAR Item 2.02 history (2022-11-07, 2023-11-02, 2024-11-04, 2025-11-05) puts the print after the window with ~95% odds, the residual being a pre-announcement tied to a capital-markets action (as in July 2026). In-window drivers are second-hand: late-October hyperscaler earnings/capex commentary and neocloud sentiment (both directions), FOMC 10/27-28 (low relevance). Momentum (+34% last month) vs reversal risk after a round-trip from $187.50 roughly cancel, with a slight pre-earnings de-risking drift. I stay near-symmetric: median ~$139, monthly sigma ~22% (82%/3.5 ~23%, trimmed slightly as no company event falls inside).

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (CY28 EPS $2.35 x 40x = $94, 35%), EV/EBITDA (NTM EBITDA ~$1.0B x 16x less $1.1B net debt / 125M = $119, 35%) and EV/sales (NTM revenue ~$2.5B x 6.0x less $1.1B / 125M = $111, 30%) = ~$108, below the $140 spot and the ~$175 sell-side average.

inputs_detail.derivation: CY27 $1.80 grown ~30%: MarketScreener CY28 consensus revenue +48% and EBITDA +53% (thin), haircut because D&A from the 155MW build and lease-funded GPUs grows faster than revenue (H1-26 D&A +56%) and gross margin is falling; replaces round-1 +20% which was not reconciled with >50% 2027 revenue growth.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q4-27 to Q3-28 window, haircut ~10% to the thinly populated CY28 consensus ($1.11B) as in the revenue path; ~40% margin on ~$2.5B revenue.

Cash $767M less converts $465.5M (after $471.8M of 2030 notes retired 7/23/26) less finance leases $578M = ~$0.28B net debt today; plus MUFG equipment-facility draws net of FCF to ~$1.1B. Operating leases excluded, consistent with adjusted EBITDA. Replaces my stale $1.21B/$1.5B.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Oct-2027 ~$2.5B x 6.0x = $15.0B EV, less ~$1.1B net debt, / 125M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: MarketScreener $1,812M; Q2 release: management 'conviction in our ability to exceed 50% growth in 2027'.
CY28 consensus $2.69B (+48%) haircut to ~+38-40% (~$2.5B) because that consensus is thinly populated and base rates for sustaining >40% growth two years running at $2B scale are low.

CY27 EV/sales: AKAM ~4.3x, CRWV 4.8x, FSLY 4.9x, ORCL 6.1x, NET 33x; median ~4.9x. 6.0x is a modest premium inside the range for >40% growth with ~40% EBITDA margins; capital intensity (gross margin 55% and falling) keeps it well below NET.

bear.story: 2027 growth undershoots the >50% commitment (capacity delays or AI-contract slippage), gross margin keeps falling and another lease/equity raise is needed; neocloud de-rating (as Aug-Sep 2026) takes the stock to ~35x a lower ~$1.95 CY28 EPS / ~4x sales. Base rate: DOCN fell ~85% from its 2021 peak and 41% peak-to-trough within 2026.

base.story: Revenue grows ~50% in 2027 to ~$1.8B, EPS ~$1.80 then ~$2.35 NTM; the multiple compresses from ~78x CY27 to ~57x NTM as growth is priced in and depreciation weighs; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: Growth beats >50% in 2027 and the thin +48% CY28 consensus proves right (NTM revenue ~$2.7B, EPS ~$2.70); AI inference demand keeps a ~85x NTM EPS / ~11x sales premium; new highs above $187.50.

comps_summary.peer_range: P/E on one basis: CY2027 street (adjusted) consensus EPS from Finviz; MSFT and ORCL calendarized to CY27 (supervisor reconciliation), Jan-FY names use FY ending Jan-2028; stockanalysis 'Forward PE' not used. 11 earning peers: 14.1x (ORCL) to 208.7x (NET), median 40.9x; infrastructure anchor (AKAM, NET, FSLY, AMZN, GOOGL, MSFT, ORCL) median 23.7x; CRWV loss-making (n/m). EV/EBITDA on one basis: CY2027 consensus EBITDA and current EV from MarketScreener (ORCL calendarized 5/12 FY27 + 7/12 FY28): CRWV 4.6x, ORCL ~8.9x, AKAM 10.3x, FSLY 23.1x, NET 128x, median 10.3x; hyperscalers and developer-software names not collected on this basis (null). CY27 EV/sales: AKAM ~4.3x, CRWV 4.8x, FSLY 4.9x, ORCL 6.1x, NET 33x. DOCN today: ~78x CY27 EPS, ~23x CY27 EBITDA, ~9.3x CY27 sales.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: P/E 40x NTM (CY28) EPS: 70% above the 23.7x infrastructure median, at the 40.9x broad median, inside the range. EV/EBITDA 16x: above the 10.3x median, inside the 4.6-128x range. EV/sales 6.0x: modestly above the ~4.9x median, inside the range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: The premium to the infrastructure anchor is growth-adjusted and limited to contracted growth that persists through the horizon: consensus and management put 2027 revenue at >50% ($1.81B) backed by $894M RPO and multi-year nine-figure AI commitments, so NTM EPS growth at the horizon (~30%) is still 2-3x the infrastructure median, and a PEG ~1.2-1.3 maps to ~40x. EBITDA growth ~50% vs ~15-25% for AKAM/ORCL/FSLY supports 16x vs ~10-14x. I do not go higher (cut from 50x) because gross margin fell from 59.9% to 55.0%, growth is funded with finance leases and two 2026 equity raises, and EPS growth lags revenue; developer-software names (75-80% gross margins, no GPU capex) are a sensitivity check, not the anchor. No sell-side outperformance call is used.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$76 the stock would be ~42x CY27 street EPS (~$1.80) and below the $77 March-2026 follow-on price, i.e. only ~1.8x the infrastructure-peer P/E and ~11x CY27 EBITDA (with ~$0.3-1.1B net debt). Ordinary 82%-vol noise can take it to $100-110; trading sustainably near $76 would most likely mean the >50% 2027 growth commitment or the AI contracts behind the RPO broke, or lease-funded capex forced a dilutive raise.

reasoning: Round 2 corrections from the supervisor fact-check: (1) my FY2027 revenue of $1.59B was below consensus with no evidence; consensus is $1.81B (+53%, MarketScreener verified) with CY28 $2.69B, and management reiterated >50% growth, so I lift NTM revenue at the horizon from $1.9B to ~$2.5B (haircut to the thin CY28 consensus). (2) Net debt was stale (included $472M of retired 2030 notes and operating leases): ~$0.28B now, ~$1.1B at horizon. (3) 125M diluted shares. (4) CY28 EPS raised from $2.15 to $2.35 (+30%). (5) Peer basis cleaned: P/E on CY27 Finviz street EPS (infra median 23.7x, broad 40.9x); EV/EBITDA now genuinely CY27 consensus (MarketScreener) instead of TTM GAAP, median 10.3x. These corrections raise every earnings/revenue input, but I also cut the multiples to the peer range with a growth-adjusted premium (P/E 50x->40x, EV/sales 9x->6x) and add an EV/EBITDA method; net fair value ~$108 (from $115). I keep my own view that fair value sits below spot rather than adopting the supervisor's $112. The 12-month distribution stays anchored on base rates: DOCN's 2021-22 ~85% drawdown, the 41% intra-2026 drawdown, and neocloud contagion episodes argue for a fat left tail; the higher, management-backed revenue path fattens the right tail slightly. Mixture of bear/base/bull ($68/$135/$230, weights 25/50/25, lognormal dispersion 30-40%) gives median ~$136, mean ~$149, P(>=140) ~0.47. The Fed prediction-market input from round 1 is dropped as of marginal relevance. Research limited: finviz/marketscreener direct fetch blocked by curl so WebFetch used; forward EV/EBITDA for hyperscalers and developer-software peers not collected on a consistent basis.
